requirements: R1: Fix the API security configuration so that authenticated requests to /api/v1/dossier/** are accepted with HTTP 200/201.
R2: Ensure the API rejects requests with invalid or missing credentials, returning HTTP 401.

slices.title: Patch SecurityConfig to resolve 401 unauthorized on valid dossier API requests
slices.jtbd: When implementing the security context fix for this epic, I want valid requests to correctly authenticate and invalid to be rejected, so that the API authentication invariants are repaired.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given valid credentials,
When requesting dossier search or reports,
Then the endpoints return the correct documented HTTP status (e.g., 200 or 201).
Given invalid credentials,
When requesting,
Then it returns 401.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce valid authenticated API request rejection rate to 0%
